CEO Performance Review Committee Meeting

Friday, June 5, 2026 - 09:00 AM

This meeting has been scheduled in accordance with the Local Government Act 1995 (WA), s.5.38(1): “A local government must review the performance of the CEO if the CEO is employed for a term of more than 1 year.”

This matter is to be considered behind closed doors pursuant to Section 5.23(2)(a), (b) and (c) of the Local Government Act 1995 as the subject matter relates to:

“Section 5.23(2)(a), (b) and (c) a matter affecting an employee or employees, the personal affairs of any person and a contract entered into, or which may be entered into, by the local government and which relates to a matter to be discussed at the meeting”
